title: Staff Software Engineer (Search Ranking)
description: P-1408 Staff Software Engineer (L6) Location: Bangalore, India At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. The Applied AI team at Databricks sits at the forefront of advancing AI/ML-powered products. As our platform grows to support hundreds of millions of customer assets—tables, notebooks, dashboards, pipelines, models, and more—finding the right asset becomes a critical user journey. You will lead enhancements to our Search Quality, focusing on search ranking, query understanding, robust evaluation frameworks, and expanding asset coverage to enable seamless search at scale. The Impact You Will Have - Lead the design and implementation of ML-based search and discovery systems that power asset retrieval across the Databricks platform. - Build automated ML and NLP pipelines for data preprocessing, query understanding, ranking, and model evaluation to enable rapid experimentation. - Drive technical strategy for search relevance, applying large language models and advanced NLP techniques to improve query understanding and ranking quality. - Develop robust evaluation frameworks for measuring search ranking improvements through offline and online experimentation. - Collaborate with product managers and cross-functional teams to define and deliver technology-first initiatives that shape the search and discovery roadmap. - Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar for ML and search engineering across the organization. What We Look For - 8+ years of software engineering experience. - 10+ years of experience developing search relevance systems at scale in production or high-impact research environments. - Experience applying large language models to search relevance problems. - Deep expertise in one or more areas including query understanding, NLP, text mining, recommendations, personalization, or conversational AI. - Strong understanding of computer science fundamentals and distributed systems. - Experience with one or more programming languages including Python, Java, Scala, or Go. - Track record of leading complex technical projects from conception through delivery. - B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog.
